_how: Sample launch brief for Video Factory itself (PRD §6 example). A real project starts from the creator's landing page or text, then the interview fills what the page doesn't say. The interview below is empty on purpose: the creator answers it when this film is made for real.

sources.ref: Product_Launch_Films_PRD.md §6, example concept for Video Factory (the creator, 2026-10-21)
the engine's README (what it does today)

product.name: Video Factory
product.description: An AI video studio run from Claude Code: the creator directs and approves; the engine writes, casts, films, edits and checks UGC ads, AI influencer clips, mini-dramas, sitcom episodes and guided meditations.

icp.role: solo founders and marketers who need a steady flow of ads, creator content and short series
icp.context: they have more ideas than production time, and they juggle separate tools for scripts, images, voices, video and editing
pains: every video means rebuilding the same production chain by hand
icp.objection: AI video looks fake and burns credits on bad takes

currentAlternative: a different tool for each step, stitched together by hand, or hiring a crew

capabilities.claim: makes UGC ads, AI influencer clips and mini-dramas in one workflow
the creator approves the concept, script, cast and Production Book before money is spent
the approved Production Book locks the budget; nothing is spent past it without a new yes
every take is checked for identity, jumps and dialogue before it can be used
each finished video passes a final QC and is delivered with a receipt

artifact: finished videos delivered with a QC receipt
tone: warm, crafted, quietly confident; a little playful
constraints: no performance numbers or customer counts: none are verified

assumptions.value: warm and crafted rather than techy

message.icp: a solo founder who markets their own product
message.pain: every video idea needs a whole crew they don't have
message.consequence: the ad, the influencer post and the series keep waiting while the idea goes stale
message.promise: you direct; Video Factory runs the production
message.before: one person juggling scripts, tools and takes
message.proof: three different kinds of video arrive finished, checked and delivered
message.differentiator: it asks for your approval at every gate and never spends past the locked budget
